name: Cafe & Pastry
description: Designed for beverage-first establishments centered on artisanal espresso and specialty tea craft, accompanied by a curated display of fine pâtisserie and morning bakes. Tailored for venues where pastries are sourced or baked in limited daily batches without a full-scale bread production line.

sections.name: Espresso & Coffee
sections.description: Core coffee program encompassing handcrafted espresso beverages, batch filter drip, and single-origin pour-overs. This section is required as coffee craft forms the foundational identity and primary daily volume of a cafe & pastry venue.

subSections.name: Espresso-Based Drinks
subSections.description: Traditional and modern espresso beverages prepared with dialed-in espresso extractions and expertly textured hot milk or water.

subSections.name: Brewed & Pour-Over
subSections.description: Batch-brewed drip coffees and manual single-origin filter methods highlighting distinct regional coffee bean origins and terroir.

subSections.name: Specialty Coffee
subSections.description: Barista-crafted specialty creations, seasonal spiced coffee drinks, signature house lattes, and affogatos.

sections.name: Tea & Specialty Hot Drinks
sections.description: Premium loose-leaf teas, wellness infusions, and comforting non-coffee hot beverages. Caters to non-coffee drinkers, evening visitors, and guests seeking botanical teas, matcha lattes, spiced chai, or rich hot chocolate.

subSections.name: Classic Teas
subSections.description: Carefully sourced loose-leaf black, green, white, and oolong teas steeped at designated water temperatures and precise durations.

subSections.name: Herbal & Fruit Infusions
subSections.description: Naturally caffeine-free herbal tisanes, floral blossoms, soothing botanicals, and dried fruit infusions.

subSections.name: Specialty Lattes & Hot Drinks
subSections.description: Steamed artisan beverages including ceremonial stone-ground matcha, house-spiced masala chai, golden turmeric latte, and artisan hot chocolates.

sections.name: Cold & Iced Drinks
sections.description: Chilled and refreshing beverages essential for warmer hours and cold drink enthusiasts. Comprises slow-steeped cold brew, iced espresso, freshly shaken iced teas, house lemonades, and velvety blended frappes.

subSections.name: Iced Coffee & Cold Brew
subSections.description: Cold-extracted single-origin brews, iced espresso tonics, iced lattes, and nitro draft pours served crisp over ice.

subSections.name: Iced Tea & Lemonade
subSections.description: Refreshing unsweetened and fruit-infused iced teas, sparkling botanical spritzers, and freshly squeezed citrus lemonades.

subSections.name: Blended & Frappe
subSections.description: Smooth ice-blended coffee frappes, matcha blends, and fruit-based blended beverages topped with artisan cold foam or whipped cream.

sections.name: Individual Pastries & Pâtisserie
sections.description: Refined single-portion French and European pâtisserie displayed in the cafe's chilled counter. Required to anchor the pastry program, offering delicate entremets, seasonal fruit tarts, choux creations, and colorful macarons that pair with artisan beverages.

subSections.name: Entremets & Mousse
subSections.description: Multi-layered French mousse cakes, mirror-glazed entremets, velvet spray finishes, and individual Bavarian cream desserts.

subSections.name: Tartlets
subSections.description: Crisp pâte sablée tart shells filled with citrus curds, ganaches, almond frangipane, and seasonal glazed fruits.

subSections.name: Choux & Éclairs
subSections.description: Airy choux pastry specialties including classic filled éclairs, craquelin cream puffs, and Paris-Brest.

subSections.name: Macarons & Petit Fours
subSections.description: Delicate Parisian almond macarons in assorted flavors, canelés de Bordeaux, mini financiers, and bite-sized confectionery.

sections.name: Croissants & Morning Bakes
sections.description: Daily morning viennoiserie, buttery laminated pastries, and traditional cafe bakes. Designed for morning traffic and quick breakfast pairings, baked fresh daily in finite batches.

subSections.name: Laminated Pastries
subSections.description: Flaky, multi-layered viennoiserie prepared with cultured butter, including classic all-butter croissants, pain au chocolat, almond croissants, and fruit danishes.

subSections.name: Scones & Muffins
subSections.description: Crumbly golden cream scones and moist bakery-style fruit, nut, and bran muffins baked fresh each morning.

timeBehavior.note: Baked fresh daily in limited quantities; available until sold out.

sections.name: Cakes & Slices
sections.description: Generous single-portion slices of multi-layered sponge cakes, baked cheesecakes, and European tortes. Perfect for dine-in afternoon tea indulgence, coffee dessert pairings, and takeaway treats.

subSections.name: Classic Cakes by the Slice
subSections.description: Individual cut slices from tall layered sponge, chiffon, and spiced sponge cakes such as spiced carrot cake, Victoria sponge, and rich chocolate fudge cake.

subSections.name: Cheesecakes
subSections.description: Portions of creamy New York baked cheesecake, caramelized Basque burnt cheesecake, and fruit-topped chilled cheesecakes.

subSections.name: Specialty Cakes
subSections.description: Distinct European and modern cake slices, including traditional Italian tiramisu, French opera cake, and multi-layer crêpe cake slices.

sections.name: Cookies & Light Sweets
sections.description: Casual sweet snacks, chewy cookies, dunking biscuits, and dessert slices suited for quick enjoyment alongside hot or iced beverages.

subSections.name: Fresh-Baked Cookies
subSections.description: Gourmet thick-baked cookies with crispy edges and chewy centers, Scottish shortbread rounds, and twice-baked almond biscotti.

subSections.name: Brownies & Bars
subSections.description: Dense Belgian dark chocolate brownies, golden butter blondies, tangy lemon curd bars, and salted caramel oat slices.

sections.name: Light Savory Bites
sections.description: Savory selections balancing the sweet pastry display. Ideal for morning cravings, brunch, and light lunches without necessitating a full kitchen or deep culinary production line.

subSections.name: Savory Pastries
subSections.description: Flaky puff pastries and savory croissants filled with cheeses, vegetables, and cured meats, alongside quiche slices.

subSections.name: Toasts & Tartines
subSections.description: Toasted artisan sourdough tartines, warm brioche sandwiches, and seasoned avocado toasts prepared to order.

choices.label: Petite Mixed Greens with Lemon Vinaigrette

sections.name: Whole Cakes (Pre-Order)
sections.description: Full-size celebration cakes, whole tarts, and multi-portion entremets made for special occasions. Requires scheduled advance pre-ordering to ensure careful baking, decorating, and proper chilling.

subSections.name: Celebration & Layer Cakes
subSections.description: Multi-tiered celebration sponge cakes decorated with piped buttercream, gourmet chocolate drips, and celebration styling.

subSections.name: Whole Pâtisserie & Tarts
subSections.description: Full-diameter French fruit tarts, large celebration entremets, and whole Basque cheesecakes crafted upon pre-order.

itemOptions.label: Requested Pickup Date & Time (Min. 48h Advance Notice)

timeBehavior.note: Pre-order only. Requires a minimum 48 hours notice prior to scheduled pickup time.

sections.name: Seasonal & Limited Menu
sections.description: Rotating seasonal creations, holiday specials, and limited-run drinks or pastries celebrating seasonal ingredients, festive holidays, and guest pastry collaborations.

subSections.name: Seasonal Drinks
subSections.description: Limited-edition holiday and weather-inspired hot and cold specialty beverages featuring seasonal spice blends, florals, or fruits.

subSections.name: Seasonal Pastries & Treats
subSections.description: Short-run festive bakes, holiday bûches de Noël, seasonal fruit tartlets, and themed confectionery available for a limited time.

systemFeatures.name: Milk Alternatives
systemFeatures.description: Allows guests to substitute standard whole milk with plant-based alternatives across all espresso, tea, and specialty beverages.

systemFeatures.name: Inventory Badges & Stock Status
systemFeatures.description: Displays real-time availability badges (such as 'Freshly Baked', 'Limited Batch', or 'Sold Out for Today') tailored for daily-batch pastries and finite counter displays.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Indicators
systemFeatures.description: Provides clear allergen disclosures (dairy, tree nuts, gluten, eggs, soy) and dietary tags (vegetarian, vegan) for delicate pastries and handcrafted drinks.

systemFeatures.name: Pre-Order Lead Time System
systemFeatures.description: Enables advance ordering and calendar time-slot selection with minimum preparation lead times, enabled specifically for whole celebration cakes.

systemFeatures.name: Sweetness Level Customization
systemFeatures.description: Provides customers with customizable sweetness tiers (0% to 120%) for barista-crafted espresso, iced, and specialty tea beverages.
